data.one_liner: Check for live network connectivity status on Android and iOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter plugin that checks for internet availability and network connectivity status. It supports stream-based observation, periodic interval checks, and on-demand queries using NetworkCapabilities on Android and NetworkMonitor on iOS.
use_when: You need to listen to live internet availability changes as a stream.
You need to perform periodic network connectivity checks with a custom duration.
You need to verify internet connection on call.
avoid_when: You prefer using more standard community packages like connectivity_plus.
You do not need native network status capabilities.
strengths: Provides both stream-based updates and on-call checks.
Allows custom lookup URLs and periodic intervals.
Native support for Android NetworkCapabilities and iOS NetworkMonitor.
weaknesses: Very early version (0.0.6) with limited ecosystem adoption.
Requires manual setup of Android permissions and minimum SDK versions.
data.setup_notes: For Android, add INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions to the manifest. Minimum SDK version is 16. For iOS, minimum required version is 12.0.

alternatives.name: connectivity_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the official and more widely adopted community standard for checking connectivity status across multiple platforms.
